title: Google 'Big Sleep' AI Agent flags SQLite 0day
summary: Podcast hosts mock Google's marketing of a Big Sleep SQLite vulnerability find while granting that AI bug-finding itself may be real.

assertions.quote: Today we're excited to share the first real world vulnerability discovered by a big sleep agent

verdicts.note: By 2025-26 AI systems (Big Sleep, AIxCC entrants, lab red-team reports) found many confirmed real vulnerabilities, though false positives remain common and human triage is still needed.

assertions.quote: this is not the way that you share new findings that have never been discussed before

verdicts.note: Labs do have incentives and many evals are self-reported, but independent evals (METR, SWE-bench, LMArena) largely confirm capability gains.
